mapper.insert: INSERT INTO short_debit_outbox(outbox_id, user_id, website_user_id, amount, usage_kind) SELECT #{id}, #{userId}, open_id, #{amount}, 'quota_cent' FROM oauth_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND platform = 'bgssai' AND del_flag = 0 AND open_id IS NOT NULL AND open_id <> '' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE outbox_id = outbox_id
mapper.select: SELECT outbox_id, user_id, website_user_id, amount, usage_kind, delivered, attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_until FROM short_debit_outbox WHERE delivered = 0 AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, outbox_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE short_debit_outbox SET lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 120 SECOND) WHERE outbox_id = #{id} AND delivered = 0 AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW())
UPDATE short_debit_outbox SET delivered = 1, lease_until = NULL WHERE outbox_id = #{id}
UPDATE short_debit_outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delay} SECOND) WHERE outbox_id = #{id} AND delivered = 0
